Mod.Name: Mouse Keybinds / 鼠标键位支持
Mod.Author: YDXF
Mod.Description: 让储物协调器的容器预设快捷键支持录入鼠标侧键（侧键 1~4），键名跟随游戏语言显示；设置改键与协调器改键时，按键冲突都会弹窗提醒，可选择一键多功能；并修复拖拽物品时滚轮偶尔无法旋转的问题。兼容游戏 1.0.0.x。 Adds mouse side button capture (side buttons 1-4) to the Storage Coordinator preset hotkeys, with key names localized to 8 languages; warns about key conflicts in both the vanilla rebinding screen and the coordinator presets (one key for multiple actions); and fixes the intermittent scroll-to-rotate failure while dragging. Compatible with game 1.0.0.x.
